prompt:
The Python package shiplib/ has 14 failing tests. Run them with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` from the project folder. Each of the 14 failures comes from a different bug, and the bugs are spread over nine of the modules in shiplib/ (dates.py, inventory.py, parser.py, pricing.py, report.py, textutil.py, shipping.py, customers.py and orders.py; __init__.py has none). Some of the failing tests go through shiplib/orders.py, so the file a failure points at is not always the file with the bug.

Part 1. Fix the bugs in shiplib/ so that all tests pass. Do not edit anything in tests/. Fix each bug the way its docstring describes, for every input and not only for the values the visible tests use: a second, larger test suite will check the same behavior with other values, including values at the edges (for example exactly at a threshold, rounding of half cents, a started step of a weight, repeated lines for one SKU, and several objects used one after another). Do not change behavior that already works, and do not change the signatures of public functions or classes, except that a mutable default argument may become None if you create the real default inside the function.

Part 2. Add a function `invoice(text, inventory, zone, weight_grams, tax_percent)` to shiplib/orders.py. It places the order in text on inventory exactly as place_order does, and returns a dict whose five keys are all integers of cents, except items:
- `items`: the list that place_order returns.
- `subtotal`: the sum of the line totals in items.
- `shipping`: 0 when shipping.free_shipping(subtotal) is true, otherwise shipping.shipping_cents(weight_grams, zone).
- `tax`: pricing.add_tax(subtotal + shipping, tax_percent) minus (subtotal + shipping), so shipping is taxed as well.
- `total`: subtotal + shipping + tax.
An unknown zone raises ValueError and an order that is out of stock raises OutOfStock. In both cases nothing is reserved, and the zone is checked even when the order would ship free. invoice relies on the code from Part 1, so it must give the right numbers only once those bugs are fixed. The hidden suite tests invoice too.
